data_fields.name: chunk_side_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: chunk_width from map config (square chunks required)

best_idea: Cache one pre-built geometry block per map chunk in a few reusable slots, pick slots from the view's corners each frame, and draw each chunk in one call.
decision_why: Static chunks of props fit zones, but the donor's 2D corner grid must become a 3D XZ cell chosen by a radius, with each miss built over several frames; the donor's sentinel, rebuild spike and frame-interval defects are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: A client test on the chunk module shows a view crossing a chunk border builds exactly one new chunk, a view wider than the cache throws, and a zone walk rebuilds at most one chunk per frame; at 375 wide the frame log shows at most four chunk draws for static ground and props per frame.
